bullets: Added Gemini 3.8 Flash to the free model picker across CLI, Web and Desktop with a 1M-token context and a $0.50 per-session cost ceiling.
Added Solar Pro 4 to the limited-access model set, now unmetered at full access alongside DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash and MiMo 2.5.
Added a proportional intro discount per subscription tier, lowering the first-period price to $5 (Starter), $19 (Plus) and $45 (Pro).
Added a hard daily Freebucks dollar ceiling that composes with restricted cohorts and shows a refusal notice when hit.
Removed Gemini 3.8 Flash from the free picker, pausing it for reliability and speed reasons while keeping the ID recognized for draining in-flight sessions.
Removed the spent dollar field from the Freebucks spend ceiling so the balance meter no longer shows a second confusing cap.
Removed the account-deletion proof utility that verified data purges before wiping Convex accounts.
Added AbortSignal support to the SDK run path so user aborts end lookup and registration requests instead of waiting silently.
Rewrote the sponsored proposal consent prompt to one sentence with No and Yes choices, clamping advertiser names and escaping control characters.
Added supported Slash commands for accepting, pulling and removing worktrees for sponsored proposals in the Freebuff CLI terminal.
Added polling for terminal states on sponsored proposals so a card keeps watching a run instead of stopping at the offered state.
Added a linked-worktree grant for sponsored runs that allows Git commits and refs while blocking hooks, config and packed refs.
Changed sponsored local-run failures to report a consent-bridge refusal reason with dedicated copy instead of blaming the OS.
Added macOS device-node grants and Linux fresh-device mounts so toolchains can write to dev-null and dev-fd safely.
Reinstated Desktop conformance waivers for rows E-3 through E-7, requiring real backend execution and user action to clear.
Updated privacy notice fields to match the September 2 policy, adding agent traces and restricted-partner language for Cloud repos.
Added new observational logging fields for ad requests, including geo tier, decision outbox status and request rejection reasons.
Added request-id and opportunity-id correlation handles to the ads fetch completed event schema for decision-contract testing.
